references.text: An earlier warning in the Mosaic Law that the people would eat their own children's flesh as punishment for disobedience
The prophecy about the siege of Jerusalem where people would eat each other's flesh due to extreme famine
Lamentations describes the fulfillment of this curse when women ate their own children during the siege of Jerusalem
Another description in Lamentations of how compassionate women cooked their own children during the siege
Historical fulfillment during the siege of Samaria when two women agreed to eat their children
Ezekiel's prophecy that fathers will eat their children and children their fathers as judgment on Jerusalem
The continuation of the same passage elaborating on the desperate situation during the siege
